title: Vedham
desc: Vijay and Sanjay become best friends after Vijay saves him from a tragedy. When he learns that Sanjay has filed for divorce, he takes it upon himself to unite the couple.

title: Amaravathy
desc: Amravati, a naive girl, runs away from home and finds shelter in Arjun's house, who takes good care of her. However, when Arjun falls in love with Amravati, her life takes a turn.

title: Namma Annachi
desc: A clash erupts between a father and a son as they deal with problems in contrasting ways.

title: Sundara Purushan
desc: A man loves his cousin, but circumstances force him to leave home. Years later, when he learns that she loves someone else, he tries to help her reunite with her lover.

title: Naan E
desc: Nani loves Bindu but is killed by a jealous businessman, Sudeep, who lusts over Bindu. Nani is reincarnated as a fly and decides to avenge his death and make Sudeep's life a living hell.
